DEPARTMENT OF GENERAL MEDICINE

2018 MBBS BATCH FORMATIVE AND SUMMATIVE ASSESSMENTS


Formative and summative assessments of the learning competencies demonstrated by the 2018 MBBS batch posted in the department of Medicine. The formative assessment is from each UG student’s  logged competency around patients evaluated regularly from date of joining. The formative assessment has been divided into non-verbal which assesses their competency in procedural domains including empathic communication and body language and verbal which assesses their ability to communicate their work through their day to day E logs. The summative assessments are based on their intermittent practical ward completion and theory written tests.
